title: CULLING MISINFORMATION FROM GEN AI: Toward Ethical Curation and Refinement
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to establishing an ethical framework and evaluating the moral/ethical implications of Generative AI, specifically focusing on misinformation, deepfakes, and social inequities. It goes beyond a brief 'Ethical Considerations' section by proposing specific policy and curation solutions like 'Civic Model Registries' and 'counter-generative systems'.
